summary: Market tone is cautiously bullish on a few high-conviction crypto names, but most of the broad tape looks selective rather than risk-on. The strongest fresh signal in the gathered material is that BTC is holding a key support zone, while Miles Deutscher remains focused on a narrow group of revenue-generating altcoins and higher-beta crypto leaders.

signals.reason: Across the listed titles he repeatedly frames Bitcoin as a short, rejection, or downside setup, including “Why and Where You NEED To Short This Bitcoin Pump,” “Don’t Touch Bitcoin Until You Watch This,” “Bitcoin Holding Won’t Save Your Altcoins From Dumping,” and “Bitcoin Rejects $81K Resistance,” which points to a bearish near-term view.
